item.title: We get dozens of letters to the editor every week. We do our best to publish as many as possible.
item.description: Every day, Ocala-News.com receives multiple letters to the editor from readers of our publication. We have a policy to generally publish one (or two) letters to the editor every day. The only criteria we have when choosing letters is as follows: A valid name and email address must be provided. We have to be able to verify the identity of the reader. If we cannot, we will not use the letter. A letter can't be a comment, it must contain more than one sentence (or just a few words). item.title: The lot rent at my Silver Springs mobile home park has doubled since new ownership took over
item.description: "My friend and I live in a mobile home park in Silver Springs. A few years ago, the property was taken over by SPE LLC, a corporation out of Sacramento, California.
